messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx + timeouts from control-plane deps (auth + org-lookup + config). Paging oncall for incidents/incidents-pager. Root cause unknown. Error spike started ~10:14 UTC. Auto-abort thresholds tripped for several upstream gateways.
sasha (oncall): On it. grabbing logs, will triage. Paging @maria for SRE help. :eyes:
maria (sre): Ack. I'm booting up traces and checking service graphs. Can you post the last 15m of 5xx rate by service?
sasha (oncall): Quick snapshot from Datadog: 
```
control-plane.gateway: 5xx rate -> 12% (baseline 0.3%)
auth-service: 5xx -> 18%
org-lookup: 5xx -> 14%
config-service: 5xx -> 9%
billing-proxy: 5xx -> 4%
```
Symptoms: timeouts to auth and org lookup causing retries -> gateway 502s.
devon (platform): Noticed a config rollout at 09:58 UTC that touched circuit-breaker defaults for auth pools. Rolling back now if we need to.
kevin (infra): FYI some hosts in us-west got OOM-killed earlier, but they recovered. Correlating with spike now.
alice (support): We have 6 customer tickets opening about failures to create API keys and app onboarding. Customer impact: signup flows failing in multiple regions.
sasha (oncall): First mitigation: enable fail-open for org-lookup where safe, and add 30s circuit-breaker to prevent hammering auth. Implementing now.
maria (sre): Running a controlled rollback of the config change would be my preference if we can do it without wider risk. @devon can you confirm if the rollback is safe?
devon (platform): Rollback is safe, it's a staged feature flag. Triggering rollback on canary -> full within the next 2 mins. Rolling back the circuit-breaker tweak.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback job started by devon at 10:19 UTC. Job ID: deploy-rollback-171234. Logs streaming...
sasha (oncall): While rollback proceeds, I'm increasing gateway timeouts and enabling request hedging to reduce 502 surface. 
ben (eng): Adding a short-term rate-limit to auth proxies to keep upstream within capacity, 5rps per client for 5 minutes.
kevin (infra): Spinning up 6 extra replicas of auth-service in us-west, increasing CPU autoscale threshold temporarily.
maria (sre): Observed immediate drop in retry storms after rollback step 1. auth-service 5xx dropped from 18% -> 7% in ~60s. org-lookup trending down too. Good sign.
alice (support): Informing customers: Drafting a brief status update to affected customers about degraded onboarding. Will post when we have a firm ETA.
sasha (oncall): Confirming: rollback completed at 10:22 UTC. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Metric alert cleared for auth-service 5xx at 10:24 UTC. However gateway 502s still 2-3% above baseline in some regions.
maria (sre): Remaining 502s look like cascaded timeouts from billing-proxy retries into config-service. There are increased latencies on config reads due to stale cache flush. We're toggling config-service cache warmup.
devon (platform): Temporary mitigation: route config reads to warm replica pool, add short TTL to reduce bursts. Applying traffic rule now.
ben (eng): Pushed a lightweight patch to reduce retry count from 3->1 in the gateway for dependent services. This should cut amplification.
sasha (oncall): Customer impact assessment: ~12% of onboarding flows failed between 10:14-10:26 UTC, affecting ~450 customers (mostly trial signups). No data loss, but some failed API key creations retried by clients.
alice (support): Posting to status page with incident id INC-2024-2243, short description, and note that mitigations are in place.
maria (sre): Telemetry shows sustained improvement: auth 5xx down to 1.5%, org-lookup under 1%, overall 502s near baseline. Leaving monitoring on for 2 hours.
kevin (infra): All added instances are healthy. No further OOMs detected. Will drain the extra replicas after monitoring window.
devon (platform): Root cause hypothesis: recent config change lowered connection pool resilience for auth and org-lookup; under a small host churn it amplified into retries and cache eviction storms. Rollback reverted the thresholds.
sasha (oncall): Next actions: 1) Create post-incident ticket with timeline and config diff (assigned to devon). 2) Run a canary test for connection pool behavior under churn (assigned to ben). 3) Update runbook with a rollback play for this config (assigned to maria). 4) Support to follow up with customers (alice).
alice (support): I'll open a support-wide customer follow-up with templated message and link to status page update.
maria (sre): Leaving the incident channel now, handoff to night SRE: @devon you have the handoff. I'll be reachable if needed. :wave:
sasha (oncall): Handoff acknowledged. I'll stay as primary until 13:00 UTC, then handoff to next oncall. Closing incident channel once postmortem ticket is created.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 10:30 UTC, severity: SEV-2, responders: sasha, maria, devon, kevin, ben, alice. Follow-up ticket: P-INC-2243.
ben (eng): Quick note: capturing the key logs here for postmortem: 
```
[10:15:12] auth-service ERROR timeout waiting for conn pool
[10:16:05] gateway WARN upstream 502 from auth-service
[10:17:40] org-lookup ERROR cache miss flood, evicting 1200 entries
[10:19:04] deploy rollback started by devon
[10:22:18] auth-service INFO recovered connections
```
devon (platform): I created the postmortem ticket P-INC-2243 and attached the config diff + rollout ID. I'll lead the postmortem and schedule a blameless review tomorrow.
sasha (oncall): Thanks team. Staying available for any lingering alerts. Closing the thread after we verify the postmortem is scheduled. :thumbsup:
